architecture.input: frozen subject-level foundation representation from Qwen3 text, WavLM speech, and OpenFace video statistics
architecture.projector: Linear-PCA(128) -> Linear(256) -> GELU -> Dropout(0.08) -> LayerNorm -> Linear(256) -> GELU
architecture.shared_symptom_layer: Linear(hidden_dim, 8) mapped to the eight PHQ shared symptom items
architecture.measurement_heads: one corpus-specific cumulative-logit ordinal head per corpus; each item has a positive discrimination slope and three ordered thresholds
core_losses: source ordinal reconstruction negative log likelihood
target calibration ordinal reconstruction negative log likelihood
auxiliary_losses: optional RBF-MMD alignment on the shared symptom layer for the measurement-aware + MMD variant
architecture.formal_loss: L_MA = NLL_src + lambda_cal*NLL_tgt_cal + lambda_l2*(||S_src||^2+||S_tgt||^2); L_MA+MMD = L_MA + lambda_mmd*MMD(S_src,S_tgt)
architecture.training_protocol: source warm-start of projector, shared symptom layer, and source ordinal head; source head initialization of the target ordinal head; core measurement-aware adaptation with source and target-calibration ordinal reconstruction; optional MMD evaluated as an auxiliary variant

secondary_endpoint.definition: shared-PHQ screening endpoint derived from the eight predicted/observed shared item scores

ablation_contracts.latent_only: same shared symptom layer and source ordinal head, no target measurement head
ablation_contracts.corpus_specific_head: source-trained shared symptom layer plus target ordinal head fit on calibration labels; retained as a weak legacy calibrated baseline
ablation_contracts.direct_target_finetune: source-warm-started direct item regressor; target calibration labels update the same shared layers without ordinal measurement heads
ablation_contracts.direct_multitask_shared_head: direct shared item regressor jointly optimized on source reconstruction and target calibration labels
ablation_contracts.shared_head_joint_adaptation: measurement-aware training schedule with source and target forced to share one ordinal head
ablation_contracts.generic_target_mlp_head: shared symptom/projector layers with corpus-specific generic MLP item heads instead of ordinal measurement parameterization
ablation_contracts.full_without_mmd: core measurement-aware pathway with joint source and target-calibration ordinal reconstruction
ablation_contracts.full_measurement_aware: measurement-aware + MMD auxiliary variant with the same ordinal reconstruction losses plus latent symptom MMD

evaluation.statistical_test: paired t-test over seed-level reconstruction_calibration_score, core measurement-aware model versus target-calibrated variants with matched labeled target exposure
evaluation.cross_regime_policy: zero-target-label baselines and target-calibrated measurement-aware methods are reported together for context, but direct superiority claims are made only within a matched target-label budget
evaluation.fair_ablation_policy: measurement-aware target-pathway claims require comparison against calibrated baselines that also allow target labels to update shared layers; corpus_specific_head alone is not used to identify the source of the gain

targeted_item_analysis.claim_policy: descriptive item-level and item-set analysis for linking the measurement audit to model behavior; not a primary superiority test
